title: Shared defender attack effects

types.title: Arrow
types.description: One shared bow-and-arrow release for every Archer and Ranger, including poison-coated arrows.
types.prompt: One bow releases one arrow: crisp dry string twang followed immediately by a narrow, fast arrow air whistle. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Sword
types.description: One compact blade swing shared by physical sword attacks.
types.prompt: One powerful sword swing: compact cutting air swish with a short restrained blade resonance. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, immediate onset and quick clean decay, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Spear and lance
types.description: One shared forward thrust for spears and lances.
types.prompt: One spear thrust: a short taut wooden shaft flex and narrow forceful forward air cut. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, immediate onset and quick clean decay, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Warhammer
types.description: A heavy physical warhammer swing; the Engineer's ranged rune bolt uses its own shared type.
types.prompt: One heavy warhammer swing: low compact air sweep, brief handle creak and a restrained metallic ring. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, immediate onset and quick clean decay, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Physical rune bolt
types.description: The Engineer's tool-driven physical armor-breaking projectile, shared across all basic ranks.
types.prompt: One armor-breaking rune bolt is released: a dry tool tap, compact compressed-air whirr and tiny restrained metallic rune ping. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no explosion, impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Heavy ballista bolt
types.description: One shared heavy physical bolt for Ballista and Fire Ballista; the name Fire Ballista does not change its physical damage.
types.prompt: One heavy ballista bolt launches: deep taut rope-string twang, short timber flex and a fast weighty projectile air whistle. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no fire, impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Stone projectile
types.description: One shared physical stone release for the Catapult and the Golem's current stone-projectile presentation.
types.prompt: One heavy stone projectile is hurled: brief gritty stone scrape, a compact hard release clack and a low rushing air whoosh. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no explosion, impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Alchemical charge
types.description: One shared thrown physical charge for both dwarf bombers.
types.prompt: One small alchemical bomb is thrown: a crisp glass-and-metal casing clack, compact lobbed air whistle and faint brief reagent hiss. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no detonation, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Toxic canister
types.description: The Dwarship's thrown toxic charge, retaining its existing physical projectile and poison effects.
types.prompt: One toxic alchemical canister is released: small metal casing clack, sharp downward air whistle and a compact wet acidic hiss. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no explosion, impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Nature and thorns
types.description: One shared woodland release for roots, thorns and the Elven King's forest-staff shots. Presentation does not change damage type.
types.prompt: One nature spell releases: flexible root-fiber creak, sharp dry bark snap, brief leafy air sweep and a soft green magical hiss. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Arcane magic
types.description: One shared generic arcane spell release, separate from lightning, holy and frost magic.
types.prompt: One arcane spell releases: a quick rising magical charge, bright glassy snap and compact clean energy puff. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, short clean decay, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Holy magic
types.description: One shared offensive holy pulse for every holy caster. Passive blessings and support auras remain silent.
types.prompt: One holy spell pulse releases: a small warm luminous bell chime and soft radiant air sweep with a short clean tail. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no impact, choir, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Frost magic
types.description: One shared crystalline frost release for frost attacks and existing frost-bounce procs.
types.prompt: One frost attack releases: crisp crystalline scrape, cold airy sweep, tiny ice ping and brief brittle frost crackle. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, short clean decay, no impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Lightning
types.description: One shared lightning discharge for primary storm attacks and existing chain or forked-lightning procs.
types.prompt: One lightning attack discharges: sharp dry electrical snap followed by a tight bright crackle and quickly fading electric fizz. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no thunderstorm, impact, music, speech or ambience.

types.title: Fire
types.description: One shared flame burst for dragon heat auras, fiery primary attacks and the Ranger Oathbreaker's existing rare fire proc.
types.prompt: One compact fire attack flares: short forceful flame rush, low warm air whoosh and restrained ember crackles that decay quickly. Isolated single game attack, close and dry, no explosion, roaring creature, music, speech or ambience.

notes: Generate exactly one take per shared attack type: 15 files, not one file per defender, rank, volley size or impact. Every Archer and Ranger shares the same arrow recording.
These are single attack-release cues. No second impact variant is requested. Playback integration can retain the existing synthesized impact layer until separately reviewed.

All 46 allied identity IDs were matched against the current generated-allied-audio.json catalogue. Lord Bernhard is an extra runtime entry and the wave-50 enemy; it is not one of the 46 allied identities.
Basic ranks share each attack-type file. Soldier rank I uses spear and ranks II-VI use sword; there are no rank-specific audio variants.

Current damage, targeting, flight eligibility, cooldowns, multishot counts and recipes remain unchanged. A sword-, spear- or hammer-looking champion still has its existing ranged combat packet unless melee=true is already present.

Current game/audio/audio.js delegates classification to the renderer. Several renderer presentations predate the latest designs: rimewatch remains a frost crossbow bolt, royalarsenal remains siege, mechanicalgolem remains a toxic dart, and emeraldgolem uses a stone shard. This generation plan follows revised weapon identity where specified without editing gameplay or render files.

Fire Ballista and Dwarf Firebomber use physical primary attacks. Their names do not authorize assigning a fire cue. Baby Fire Dragon and Mother Fire Dragon have zero primary damage and continuous fire auras; no projectile attack is invented for them.

Spell mixtures reuse existing shared files: Elemental Male Dragon uses lightning plus fire aura; Ancient Dragon Patriarch uses fire plus forked lightning; Lady Claire uses arcane plus lightning procs; Ranger Oathbreaker uses arrow plus its rare successful fire proc. Poison damage-over-time ticks are silent.
Nature magic is a presentation category. Elven King retains physical three-shot damage, while Druid-family thorns retain poison damage. A shared sound does not unify their game damage types.

Chain events currently omit explicit source/ability tags, including bouncing frost. Reliable proc attribution is needed before future runtime routing. The rare fire splash has no dedicated emitted event. This is a generation-and-review plan, not a claim that new assets are already integrated.

Passive blessings, range auras, armor-reduction auras, winter auras, healing suppression, health-recovery procs and detection produce no additional requested attack recordings. No healing or support cue is generated.

When integrated later, play one shared cue per simultaneous attack volley, gate repeated fire-aura pulses and avoid sounding every target, damage-over-time tick or support frame. Honor mute, pause, speech priority and the existing clutter limits.

game/core/blueprints.js defines maze plans and contains no defender weapon or attack-type authority. Current combat data, latest design descriptions and actual render/audio classification were checked independently.
